title: append between pages
expectation: a foreign append observed mid-read either rejects or is re-read into the final coherent cut
actual: accepted only after re-reading the final cut: asOfSeq=600 eventCount=601 refs=0

title: inbox insert between pages
expectation: a pending inbox insertion observed mid-read either rejects or is projected from the final coherent cut exactly once
actual: accepted only after re-reading the final cut: asOfSeq=600 eventCount=601 refs=1

title: inbox removal between pages
expectation: a pending input removed mid-read is absent from the verified final projection (no resurrection)
actual: accepted only after re-reading the final cut: asOfSeq=601 eventCount=602 refs=0

title: same-length early rewrite
expectation: a same-length rewrite of an already-observed early event must not yield a stale/mixed accepted projection
actual: rejected observed change with NativeHistoryError: NativeHistoryError: Native history changed outside the trusted recovery suffix

title: append after EOF
expectation: an append after a first-pass EOF is never accepted as if the earlier cut were current
actual: rejected observed change with NativeHistoryError: NativeHistoryError: Native history changed outside the trusted recovery suffix

title: append during projection
expectation: a write that lands while the projector runs must not be silently dropped from the accepted cut
actual: rejected observed change with NativeHistoryError: NativeHistoryError: Native history changed outside the trusted recovery suffix

title: shrinking log
expectation: a stored log that shrank below the observed prefix must reject, never return a silently shortened/mixed history
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_READ: NativeHistoryError: Native history read failed

title: cancel during read
expectation: cooperative cancellation rejects with a diagnosable error, releases the handle and posts no acceptance receipt
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_CANCELLED: NativeHistoryError: Native history recovery was cancelled

refs.notes: cancellation is cooperative in the frozen SDK; the check is "rejects and releases", not a hard realtime bound

title: pre-aborted signal
expectation: an aborted caller signal rejects before any read/acceptance receipt
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_CANCELLED: NativeHistoryError: Native history recovery was cancelled

title: absolute deadline option
expectation: a supplied absolute deadlineAtMs shortens recovery and rejects with a deadline error, releasing the handle
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_DEADLINE: NativeHistoryError: Native history recovery exceeded its deadline

title: expired deadline option
expectation: an absolute deadline in the past rejects without opening/using a native handle or accepting a projection
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_DEADLINE: NativeHistoryError: Native history recovery exceeded its deadline

title: recovery deadline
expectation: an exceeded recovery deadline rejects with a diagnosable error and releases the handle
actual: rejected with NativeHistoryError code=NATIVE_HISTORY_DEADLINE: NativeHistoryError: Native history recovery exceeded its deadline
